title: Solicit Quiet Donations
description: A letter here, a luncheon there. The order's coffers do not fill themselves.

outcome.result_text: Envelopes arrive, unmarked and unremarked. The ledger swells a little.

title: Keep the Faith
description: Readings, rites, and the small disciplines that bind initiates to the work.

outcome.result_text: The candles are tended and the oaths renewed. The order holds together.

title: Go to Ground
description: Suspend the visible work and let the city's interest cool.

outcome.result_text: For a while the order is only rumour again, and rumour forgets.

title: Hold a Séance for the Grieving
description: The bereaved come seeking the dead. Some of them stay seeking more.

outcome.result_text: Most leave comforted. One lingers at the door, and asks what else is true.

title: Minister to the Poor
description: {actor.name} carries bread and the order's quiet word into the tenements.

on_success.result_text: Gratitude is a kind of currency, and the parish remembers a kind face.

on_failure.result_text: A curate asks too many questions. Charity, it seems, is watched.

title: Work the Waterfront
description: {actor.name} learns whose palms to grease along the North End docks.

on_success.result_text: Crates move and questions do not. The order takes its cut of the dark trade.

on_failure.result_text: A misjudged word, and the wrong men take an interest in the order's errand.

title: Haunt the Locked Stacks
description: {actor.name} reads where the lamps are kept low and the catalogue lies.

on_success.result_text: Pages that were never meant to be copied are copied all the same.

on_failure.result_text: Something in the marginalia reads back. The work leaves a residue.

title: Plant a Story
description: {actor.name} buys a columnist a drink and a narrative.

on_success.result_text: By morning the city believes a useful, harmless lie.

on_failure.result_text: The editor smells the setup and prints a question instead.
